svg.title: TTA Notifications v0.6 — In-band subscription (receiver-initiated), event notification, follow-up pull POC implementation: component/subscription (docs/tta-notifications-v06/)

g.text: TTA Notifications v0.6 — In-band subscription (receiver-initiated), event notification, follow-up pull
Step 0: agreements (design time, out of band)
Pre-agreed between the parties, configured on both knooppunten:
Step 1: authorization basis (sender side) — the vendor supplies it, the knooppunt enforces it
the "who may be notified of what" record;
looked up by the authz hook before activation
and before every send (POC: stub, logs, always allows)
record local consent record on the resource
(for COW: the Coordination Task naming Task.owner
one basis governs both the notification
and the follow-up pull; no separate registration.
The authz hook then asks the PDP instead of
its own table — the hook placement stays the same
Step 2: subscription intent (receiver side, in-band creation)
per-partner config first, mCSD only as fallback
validate: topic in agreed list, mode in allowed modes,
match topic + filter (Task, create/update, owner URA)
via the PDP against the PIP record (see step 1);
consent via the Mitz component. Withdrawal = record removed
the knooppunt is now in the pull/data path —
the price of aliasing non-compliant ids (RQ 8)
